nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint256) tracking ETH balances per beneficiary; written in deposit/buy paths and decremented in withdraw paths.
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) [owner][token] tracking credited ERC20 balances per user.
View function looping over IMultiToken tokens and summing weights; makes external calls to changeableTokenCount/tokens/weights.
View function returning the caller-supplied account's tokenBalances for a list of tokens.
Payable external deposit crediting ETH to balances[_beneficiary] and pulling ERC20 tokens via transferFrom from msg.sender.
Internal withdrawal that sends ETH via _to.transfer and ERC20 tokens via token.transfer, then decrements balances/tokenBalances of msg.sender.
External wrapper delegating to withdrawInternal with caller-supplied recipient, value and token arrays.
External function that reads allBalances(msg.sender) and calls withdrawInternal to withdraw everything.
Internal function that performs an arbitrary low-level call.value(_data) to _exchange, then decrements balances and credits tokenBalances.
Internal function approving tokens to an IMultiToken, computing best mint amount and calling _mtkn.mint for msg.sender.
Payable public batch function crediting msg.value and performing up to ten buyInternal calls with early returns.
Payable public function calling buy10 then mintInternal on the multi-token.
Payable public single-buy entry point crediting msg.value then calling buyInternal.
Caller-controlled address used to index balances/tokenBalances and as transferFrom source and mint recipient.
_exchange.call.value(_value)(_data) low-level arbitrary external call in buyInternal with caller-controlled target and calldata.
_to.transfer(_value) ETH transfer to an arbitrary recipient executed before state balance updates in withdrawInternal.
Arithmetic on balances/tokenBalances via SafeMath add/sub and raw loop arithmetic; relies on assertions for overflow/underflow safety.
External calls to user-supplied ERC20 contracts (balanceOf, transfer, transferFrom, approve) and IMultiToken (mint, totalSupply, tokens, weights).
deposit parameter _beneficiary: address credited in balances and tokenBalances.
deposit/withdraw parameter _tokens: array of ERC20 token addresses supplied by caller.
deposit parameter _tokenValues: array of token amounts credited to the beneficiary.
Local ERC20 token handle created from _tokens[i] inside deposit/withdraw loops.
Local token amount read from _tokenValues[i] inside deposit/withdraw loops.
Local snapshot of the contract's token balance before transferFrom in deposit, used in the post-transfer require.
allBalances parameter _account: arbitrary address whose tokenBalances are read.
withdraw/withdrawInternal parameter _to: arbitrary recipient of ETH and tokens.
withdraw/withdrawInternal parameter _value: ETH amount subtracted from msg.sender balances.
Local snapshot of the contract token balance before token.transfer in withdrawInternal, used in the post-transfer require.
buyInternal parameter _exchange: caller-controlled address targeted by the low-level value call.
buyInternal parameter _data: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the low-level call.
mintInternal parameter _mtkn: caller-supplied IMultiToken contract that is approved and minted on.
mintInternal parameter _notUsedValues: array reused to store pre-mint balances for post-mint accounting.
buy10 parameter _data1: calldata forwarded to the first buyInternal call.
buy10 parameter _exchanges: array of exchange addresses used as low-level call targets.
buy10 parameter _values: array of ETH values forwarded to buyInternal calls.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the payer whose tokens are pulled by deposit via transferFrom.
withdrawInternal indexes and decrements balances and tokenBalances of msg.sender.
withdrawAll reads allBalances(msg.sender, _tokens) to determine amounts to withdraw.
buyInternal credits tokenBalances[msg.sender][token] after the external call.
buy10 credits balances[msg.sender] with msg.value.
mintInternal approves and mints multi-token for msg.sender and updates tokenBalances[msg.sender].
msg.sender is used as the balance key when updating balances in withdraw/buy flows.
deposit writes balances[_beneficiary] with the received msg.value.
deposit credits tokenBalances[_beneficiary][token] with _tokenValues[i].
allBalances reads tokenBalances[_account][_tokens[i]] for the supplied account.
allBalances returns values read from the tokenBalances state mapping.
Caller-supplied _tokens addresses are cast to ERC20 and invoked externally.
Local token handle derived from _tokens is used for external balanceOf/transfer/transferFrom calls.
Caller-supplied _mtkn contract is invoked externally (totalSupply, tokens, approve, mint).
Caller-controlled _to receives ETH through transfer before balances/tokenBalances are updated.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] via SafeMath sub, underflow guarded only by assertions.
Attacker-controlled _exchange is the target of the low-level call.value in buyInternal, allowing code execution before state updates.
Arbitrary _data is forwarded as calldata to the low-level exchange call.
Pre-transfer snapshot tokenBalance is subtracted inside a require to validate the transferred amount.
Pre-transfer snapshot balance is added to tokenValue via SafeMath add in the deposit require.
_notUsedValues[i] is subtracted by the post-mint token balance to derive spent amounts, risking underflow if balances change.
Element of _exchanges is used as the _exchange target for each buyInternal call.
Element of _values is used as the ETH _value forwarded to each buyInternal call.
_data1 calldata flows into buy10 and then into the first buyInternal call.
withdraw delegates execution to withdrawInternal.
withdrawAll delegates execution to withdrawInternal after collecting balances.
buy10mint first executes buy10.
buy10mint executes mintInternal after buying.
buy10 performs sequential buyInternal calls with early returns.
buyOne delegates to buyInternal.
sumWeightOfMultiToken calls external IMultiToken getters (changeableTokenCount, tokens, weights).
deposit increases balances[_beneficiary] by msg.value.
withdrawInternal decreases balances[msg.sender] by _value.
withdrawInternal decreases tokenBalances[msg.sender][token] for each withdrawn token.
mintInternal decreases tokenBalances[msg.sender][token] for each approved token.
The low-level exchange call executes external code before balances[msg.sender].sub(_value), enabling reentrant balance manipulation.
During the external call in buyInternal the tokenBalances entry is still stale, allowing reentrant double-crediting.
ETH transfer via _to.transfer executes before balances[msg.sender] is decremented, allowing reentrant withdrawal.
Recipient code can re-enter before tokenBalances[msg.sender][token] is decremented in withdrawInternal.

normalization_plan.reason: _beneficiary is a deposit parameter used only to index the balances state var written by deposit.
_tokens only supplies ERC20 addresses consumed by the deposit loop.
_tokenValues only supplies credited amounts inside the deposit loop.
Local ERC20 token handle exists solely within deposit/withdraw token loops.
Local tokenValue is a loop-scoped copy of _tokenValues[i] in deposit.
Local balance snapshot is used only for the deposit post-transfer require.
_account is only used to read tokenBalances inside allBalances.
_to is the recipient of the ETH transfer unsafe operation in withdrawInternal.
_value feeds the SafeMath sub arithmetic on balances in withdrawInternal.
tokenBalance snapshot is used only for the withdrawInternal post-transfer require arithmetic.
_exchange is the caller-controlled target of the low-level call.value unsafe operation.
_data is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the low-level call unsafe operation.
_mtkn is the untrusted multi-token contract externally invoked by mintInternal.
_notUsedValues is reused by mintInternal for pre-mint balance snapshots used in subtraction arithmetic.
_data1 is forwarded by buy10 into the first buyInternal low-level call.
_exchanges supplies the call targets for buy10's sequence of buyInternal calls.
_values supplies the ETH amounts for buy10's sequence of buyInternal calls.
